headline: Autumn squeeze for Italians, Codacons raises alarm | 633 euros more per family for electricity, gas and fuel
summary: Codacons estimates Italian families will face about 633 euros more per year due to higher electricity, gas and fuel costs. The consumer group raised the alarm ahead of autumn.
why: Energy and fuel costs feed into household inflation and disposable income, which matter for consumer spending and central bank policy.
